meta.review_notes: Camera and microphone access is not addressed in the privacy policy. Please verify if the app requests these permissions.

app.name: Aisle - Indian Dating App
app.description: An Indian dating app designed for meaningful relationships, connecting like-minded people looking for love.

verdict.one_liner: Aisle does not sell your data and keeps chats confidential, but your photos may be analyzed by an external face recognition tool and your profile is visible to all users.
verdict.summary: Aisle is an Indian dating app with stronger privacy practices than most competitors. It explicitly states it does not sell personal data to third parties, keeps chat messages confidential, and allows account deletion. Personal data may be erased automatically after five years of inactivity. However, it states it may use an external face recognition tool for photo selection, shares your approximate location with nearby users if enabled, and monitors chat messages with content filters.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Aisle has stronger privacy practices than most dating apps, with a clear no-sale policy, confidential chats, and automatic data deletion after five years of inactivity. Be aware that your photos may be processed by an external facial recognition tool and your profile is visible to all users.

red.title: Photos may be analyzed by external face recognition tool
red.plain_english: Aisle states it may use an external face recognition tool to analyze your uploaded photos and select the best ones for your profile.

red.title: Profile visible to all users
red.plain_english: Aisle states your account will be visible to other users, and members can perform targeted searches based on information you share.

red.title: Chat messages may be filtered for inappropriate content
red.plain_english: Aisle states it uses filter software to scan chat messages and other written content for inappropriate language, advertisements, or links, and reserves the right to erase offensive content.

red.title: Approximate location may be shared with other users
red.plain_english: Aisle states you can choose to share your geolocation with other users, limited to an accuracy of 0.5 kilometers at most.

green.title: Explicit no-sale policy
green.plain_english: Aisle explicitly states that it does not sell your personal data to third parties.

green.title: Chat messages kept confidential
green.plain_english: Aisle states your chat messages are strictly confidential and are only processed to give you access to your chat history.

green.title: Easy account deletion
green.plain_english: Aisle states you can delete your account by logging in, or contact support to request deletion of your data from their records.

green.title: Data auto-deleted after five years of inactivity
green.plain_english: Aisle states that if you have not logged in for five years, your personal data may be erased from their records.

green.title: No data collection from minors
green.plain_english: Aisle states it does not collect data from minors and commits to deleting all data on any minor found on the platform.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Aisle does not clearly state whether the app accesses your camera or microphone.
categories.detail: The privacy policy mentions uploading pictures but does not explicitly describe camera or microphone access. It is unclear whether the app requests these permissions.
concerns: Policy is silent on camera and microphone access

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: You can choose to share your approximate location with other users. Aisle states it never shares accurate geolocations, limiting accuracy to 0.5 kilometers at most.
categories.detail: Geolocation is optional. If enabled, it is shared with other users who have also enabled it, with accuracy limited to 0.5 kilometers at most.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can choose to share your geolocation... Your geolocation will be shared with other users who have shared their geolocation. Please note that we never share accurate geolocations with Aisle users – the accuracy is limited to 0.5 kilometers at the most.

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: The policy mentions that you may select a person from your device's contacts to send an invitation, but does not clearly state that Aisle collects or stores your contacts list.
categories.detail: The policy states that users can select a person directly from their contacts list to send an invitation message from their personal account. It does not explicitly describe collection or storage of contact data by Aisle.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you choose to invite someone to join our Website or App, you may select a person directly from your contacts list on your device and send a text, email or message from your personal account.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Aisle requires you to upload pictures to create an account. The policy does not mention broader access to files or storage on your device.
categories.detail: Photo upload is mandatory for account creation. The policy does not describe accessing other files, file metadata, or storage beyond user-uploaded images.
categories.policy_excerpt: When creating Your Account, it is necessary to upload pictures of yourself... Images uploaded by you may be modified by us to make them more presentable on the platform.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Aisle states it does not sell your personal data to third parties. It says it may use an external face recognition tool for photo selection and shares data with service providers and storage partners, including special or sensitive personal information where necessary. Your profile is visible to other users.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly states it does not sell personal data. It mentions using an external face recognition tool, hosting data with storage partners, and transmitting data to service providers and subcontractors. The policy explicitly states that Aisle may provide 'Personal Information and special/sensitive personal information' to third-party service providers. Profile data is visible to other users for matchmaking.
categories.policy_excerpt: We do not sell your Personal Data to third parties... We may use an external face recognition tool... your personal data may be hosted by our storage partners... transmitted to Aisle service providers and subcontractors... to third parties who provide certain services available on the Aisle on its behalf.

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Aisle collects your name, email, phone number, age, height, religion, and photos to create your account. If you use Facebook or LinkedIn login, that data is linked to your account.
categories.detail: Account creation requires personal information. Optional social login links external data. Profile is publicly searchable by other users.
categories.policy_excerpt: You will be asked to register before you can use Aisle... name, email ID etc... name, pictures of you, a description of yourself... You can create Your Account through Facebook or Linkedin Login... Members of Aisle can perform targeted searches on the basis of age, religion and other information that users share on their accounts.

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Aisle states it places tracking cookies and analyzes your browsing patterns to suggest people you might like. It may send you promotional push notifications.
categories.detail: The policy mentions placing tracking cookies with consent and conducting analysis of browsing patterns. Push notifications may include suggestions and promotional material. There is no mention of external advertising or ad networks.
categories.policy_excerpt: Place tracking cookies... conducting an analysis of your browsing pattern and history... we may also send you push notifications with suggestions of people you might like and other promotional material.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Aisle states it does not collect data from minors and commits to deleting all data on any minor found on the platform.
categories.detail: Terms require users to be at least 18. Explicit policy to delete minor data if discovered.
categories.policy_excerpt: Aisle shall not collect data from minors. Should a Member lie about his/her date of birth... Aisle commits to deleting all data on the minor in question as soon as possible.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Aisle states it may collect your IP address, browser type, device type, operating system, and internet service provider information.
categories.detail: Standard collection of technical information including IP address, browser type, device type, OS, and ISP.
categories.policy_excerpt: we will process your IP address, login information, customer service history, time zone settings, device ID, browser language... This data may include your browser type and version, the type of your computer or mobile device and technical information about your means to connect to our Websites.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Aisle states it may process your device ID, browser type, and device type when you use the app.
categories.detail: The policy mentions processing device ID along with other technical information. It does not clearly explain how the device ID is used.
categories.policy_excerpt: we will process your IP address, login information, customer service history, time zone settings, device ID, browser language

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Aisle states it may use an external face recognition tool to analyze your uploaded photos and select the best ones for your profile.
categories.detail: External face recognition tool is used to analyze uploaded photos for quality, composition, and authenticity. This implies biometric analysis by a third party.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may use an external face recognition tool and other techniques to select the best pictures for Your Account. This selection may be based on features like image quality, composition and authenticity.
concerns: Facial analysis by third party implied

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Aisle states that when you make an in-app purchase, you enter details for your account with your Software Store. The policy does not state that Aisle stores your payment card details.
categories.detail: In-app purchases are processed through Apple or Google. The policy does not describe Aisle directly collecting or storing payment card information.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you make an in-app purchase, you will be prompted to enter details for your account with your Software Store.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: Aisle states you can request deletion of your data at any time, but backups may be retained for up to three years, your email and phone number may be kept for payment matters, and generic non-personal data may be kept for internal use. Data may also be erased automatically after five years of inactivity.
categories.detail: Account deletion is available by logging in or contacting support. The policy states a safety retention window of up to three years for backups, and retention of email and phone number for payment communication. Generic non-personal data (number of logins, subscription term, payment method, etc.) may also be stored for internal use. Additionally, personal data may be erased automatically after five years of inactivity.
categories.policy_excerpt: you can always contact our support team through your registered email address with a request to delete your data from our records... we store your details as backup for a safety retention window of upto three years following account deletion... We only retain your email address and phone number in order to be able to contact you with regard to payment matters.
concerns: Backups retained for up to three years
Email and phone number retained after deletion

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Aisle states it may update its privacy policy unilaterally and that continued use after changes indicates acceptance. It says you will see a pop-up for significant changes.
categories.detail: Changes are effective upon publication. Users notified via pop-up for significant changes. Continued use constitutes acceptance.
categories.policy_excerpt: we may unilaterally update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When there is a significant change in this Privacy Policy, you will see a pop up in the app which you will have to accept before you can continue to use Aisle. Continued use of the Aisle app and website after revision indicates the user's acceptance of the terms of use and privacy policy.
